Ariel (CS): heads up — Zenfora org (zenfora-01) shows a sharp drop in prod requests starting ~09:40 PT, ~78% down vs baseline. main endpoint /v1/generate affected. https://app.redwood.com/orgs/zenfora-01 :eyes:
Mike C (CS): ugh. any quick numbers or recent config changes?
Ariel (CS): baseline ~1.9k req/day, last 24h 420. no recent model changes on our side. quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE org='zenfora-01' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours';
```
result: 420
Sam S (AE): I heard Procurement opened a pilot with NimbusAI last week — Lina (new PM) mentioned evaluating alternatives during the QBR. I can ping Mark in procurement.
Jade P (PM): any feature-flag toggles or quota changes for this org? also check if they switched keys or rotated creds.
Elliot (Sales Eng): I'll run a smoke from our side and compare latency/5xx across the last 48h. also will validate billing status (card, invoicing).
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2073 created (low-usage-detection) — assigned to Ariel (CS) and Mike C (CS) :rotating_light:
Ariel (CS): no billing failures in billing dashboard. we do see a webhook 'logs-forwarder' disabled 2027-03-03 09:41 but that shouldn't affect generate calls.
Mike C (CS): plan: 1) confirm procurement pilot scope 2) sync with Lina + Mark + AE + SE today 3) prepare quick value notes (accuracy evals, latency, cost) 4) set escalation if pilot continues beyond 2 weeks.
Sam S (AE): booking a 30m with Lina + Mark + Elaine (CTO) — proposing 11:30 PT today :calendar: — will include a 1-slide comparison (Redwood vs Nimbus) and usage snapshot.
Ariel (CS): I'll prepare a ramp-back playbook in case they want to revert traffic: create a canary route, fallback model variant, and instructions for customers to toggle. adding checklist to the thread.
Jade P (PM): capture competitor eval criteria in the meeting: price per 1k tokens, end-to-end latency, model fidelity on our eval set, support/SLA, and deployment flexibility.
Mike C (CS): setting risk flag in CS tracker — Renewal risk: medium-high if pilot expands. tagging Q3 renewal owner. :thumbsup:
Elliot (Sales Eng): I'll bring perf graphs and a quick AB on inference cost for their typical prompt mix.
Sam S (AE): added calendar invite and stakeholders. will post recording + notes.
Ariel (CS): thanks — after the sync I'll post findings and next actions (quick wins + escalation steps).
